document.about: Western Digital WD Gold data sheet. Page 1 sets a sidebar (`Highlights` at 14pt) at the left, read first, and the 17pt product title at the right.

notes: 2026-11-24 (#204): the document title was the largest of the first blocks in reading order, so a sidebar's heading read first, or a category strip as large as the title and set above it, was taken for it.
2026-11-26: the document's title is a `doco:Title`, the document's header, apart from its sections, as a Word document's and a deck's are. The title's checks look for it there.
2026-11-26 (#455): a title is a `doco:Title` only where it is sure, its evidence naming how (`metadata`, `outline`, `type`); the title's checks no longer name its evidence.

checks.issue: `Highlights`, the sidebar's heading, was the document title.
